title: Local Cluster & kubectl Fluency
summary: Build a reusable multi-node kind cluster with port mappings, mounts and local images, master kubeconfig contexts, and become fast and precise with kubectl and k9s.
objectives: Write a kind config with multiple nodes, port mappings, extra mounts and node labels
Load locally built images into kind and choose the right imagePullPolicy
Explain kubeconfig clusters, users and contexts, and switch clusters and namespaces safely
Extract exactly the data you need with -o wide/yaml/json/jsonpath/custom-columns
Generate manifests with --dry-run=client -o yaml and preview changes with kubectl diff
Debug with logs, exec, cp, port-forward, events, top, wait and rollout
Navigate a cluster quickly with k9s, aliases and shell completion
